title: ‘Win the Mall’ Continues Netflix’s Reality Competition Series Hot Streak
summary: Netflix's growing reality competition slate also includes 'Wonka's Golden Ticket,' 'Million Dollar Secret,' 'Squid Game: The Challenge', 'Wonka’s Golden Ticket,' 'Lock Upp' and 'Physical 100.'
body_markdown:
A remote jungle. A luxurious lakeside resort. Willy Wonka’s famous chocolate factory.


Our reality competition series are known for their unique settings and our next entry definitely delivers.


[Win the Mall](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/win-the-mall-season-1-release-date-news) , debuting today on Netflix, is described as part shopping spree and part social strategy. This high-gloss reality competition drops players into a living mall where they’ll fight to outshop, outsmart, and outlast one another — and only one will walk away with the keys to the ultimate prize.


Win the Mall


is the latest buzzy addition to our growing US reality competition slate, including


Million Dollar Secret, Outlast, Squid Game: The Challenge


and


Wonka’s Golden Ticket


. It also comes on the heels of impressive global entries like


Lock Upp


and the


Physical 100


franchise. “We want to create unscripted entertainment that prompts our viewers to sit up and say, ‘Oh, that feels like a different take,’” said Brandon Riegg, Netflix’s Vice President of Nonfiction Series and Sports. “The unscripted community is now coming to us with excitement saying, ‘We can be bold and lean into risk and take these swings.’”


Bringing Roald Dahl’s beloved book


Charlie and the Chocolate Factory


to life


— chocolate rivers, lickable wallpaper and all —


Wonka’s Golden Ticket


awarded one two-person a $3 million prize earlier this year. The sweet series spent three weeks on the Global Top 10 English TV list in September and reached the Top 10 in 63 countries.


A far cry from the colorful world of Willy Wonka, India’s


[Lock Upp](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/lock-upp-release-date-news) forced celebrity


contestants


“inmates” to live behind bars where a game of power and redemption determined who stays or goes. Netflix’s first daily reality series in India logged


125 million viewing hours


during its six-week run, ranking #1 in India for seven weeks and boasting the most viewing ever of any title on Netflix in India.


[Season 2](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/after-a-landmark-first-season-lock-upp-sach-ya-sazaa-is-set-to-return-soon-with-season-2-on-netflix) is on the way.


In nearby South Korea,


[Physical 100](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/physical-100-release-date-cast-news) kicked off a cultural phenomenon that has since expanded to


[Italy](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/the-official-trailer-of-physical-100-italy-on-netflix-from-september-11) and


[Mexico](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/efecto-netflix-habilidad-fisica-mexico) (already renewed for Season 2), in addition to


[Physical: Asia](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/physical-asia) , which brought together eight countries including Korea, Japan, Thailand, Mongolia, Türkiye, Indonesia, Australia, and the Philippines. The show, which sees 100 contestants in top physical shape compete to claim the honor of the ultimate physique, has amassed


59.9 million views


since its 2023 debut and was the first unscripted series to lead Netflix’s Global Non-English TV Top 10 list. The franchise has spent


16 weeks in the Global Top 10, reaching #1 in 15 countries and hitting the Top 10 in 91 countries


.


[US](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/physical-100-usa-season-1-release-date-news) , French and


[Swedish](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/meet-the-100-contestants-of-physical-100-sweden) versions are up next.


"Because we are a global service, we are able to have continuity and focus over making the various international editions seamless for our members,” said Riegg.


[Million Dollar Secret](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/million-dollar-secret)


was anything but, drawing


23.5 million views


since its 2025 debut. The series, in which a group of contestants battles to find out who the secret millionaire is and dethrone them, logged three weeks in the Global Top 10 English TV list and hit the Top 10 in 50 countries. And the secret is out that the upcoming third season will feature a


[celebrity twist](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/celebrity-million-dollar-secret-release-date-news) .


Another Netflix reality show adding some familiar faces?


[Squid Game: The Challenge](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/squid-game-the-challenge) , which returns in January for a


[special VIP edition](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/squid-game-the-vip-challenge-celebrities-cast) . Since debuting in 2023, the reality spinoff of the award-winning phenomenon, which like the show awarded one contestant $4.56 million, clocked


53.2 million views over two seasons


, ranking in the Global Top 10 English TV list for seven weeks and making the Top 10 in all 93 countries tracked.


“


Squid Game


is a cultural phenomenon that most everyone is familiar with, so it was a real roll of the dice to do the reality version," said Riegg. "And I think conventional wisdom would’ve said, ‘Don’t do it.’ But we did lean into it and it was massively spectacular.”


And one of our earliest hits in the reality competition space, 2023’s


[Outlast](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/outlast) , has already expanded to new terrain — literally — moving from the icy-cold Alaskan wilderness to the muggy tropics of Panama. The first two seasons of


Outlast,


in which players must band together and survive off the land with few supplies to win $1 million,


accumulated 32.3 million views, hitting the Global Top 10 English TV list for three weeks and reaching the Top 10 in 27 countries. The Panama-set third season, titled


Outlast: The Jungle


, drew


8.1 million views


, making the Global Top 10 English TV list for two weeks and reaching the Top 10 in 60 countries.


Some of the most compelling competitions can even start at home. Brazil’s


[Stranded With My Mother-in-Law](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/pt-br/artigos/ilhados-com-a-sogra-quarta-temporada-participantes-trailer) and


[Mom Knows Best?](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/mom-knows-best-now-playing-on-netflix) put the relationship between mothers and their children (or their children's partners) at the center of their games and connected deeply with their audiences —


Stranded With My Mother-in-Law’s


fourth season drops November 25, adding to the show's more than 25 million combined view hours.


And the games are far from over. Coming up, we have reality adaptations of the beloved board games


[Clue](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/clue-season-1-release-date-news) ,


[Monopoly](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/monopoly-season-1-release-date-news-casting)


and


[Simon Says](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/simon-says-season-1-release-date-news) . We’ll also have a


[new survival competition series](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/alan-ritchson-survival-competition-series-release-date-news) hosted and executive-produced by Alan Ritchson, star of the hit Netflix film


War Machine


.


Are you ready to play? Check out


[Win the Mall](https://www.netflix.com/title/81906729) and more of our reality competitions


[here](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/reality-competition-shows-to-stream-now-on-netflix) and


[here](https://www.netflix.com/browse/genre/49266) .
